note_title: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题

callouts.id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#1
callouts.title: 问题1

classification_result.id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#1

if_problem.statement_en: Given that $x_n \to A$, find $$\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \frac{x_n + x_{n-1} + \cdots + x_1}{n}.$$
key_techniques: splitting the sum into initial and tail parts

callouts.id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#2
callouts.title: 问题2
callouts.body: 假设$x_n\to A,y_n \to B$证明$$\frac{x_1y_n+\cdots +x_ny_1}{n}\to AB$$

classification_result.id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#2

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $x_n \to A$ and $y_n \to B$. Prove that $$\frac{x_1y_n+\cdots +x_ny_1}{n}\to AB.$$
key_techniques: splitting into main term and error terms

callouts.id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#3
callouts.title: 想法
callouts.body: 如果你发现一个$S_n'$其形式比$S_n$更好得到渐近展开，比如说对$S_n$做某种放缩，只要放缩整体的误差是被$O(g(n))$控制起来的(这里表示目标误差精度)，那么最终的渐近展开是相同的。

classification_result.id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#3

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Replace by a Better-Behaved Approximation with Controlled Error
if_strategy_template.summary_en: If one can find a modified quantity $S_n'$ whose asymptotic expansion is easier to derive than that of $S_n$, then it is enough to compare $S_n$ and $S_n'$. When the total discrepancy is controlled by $O(g(n))$, at the target precision, the two quantities have the same final asymptotic expansion.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this when a direct asymptotic analysis is difficult, but a suitably bounded approximation, comparison, or squeezing produces a simpler expression with the same asymptotic accuracy.
